paragraphs.text: You smash the pillar at its most distorted point. You hear a crack, so you draw back your weapon and smash it again. The pillar buckles and snaps. Thunder sounds above your head. You have a frozen moment of satisfaction as your pursuers look up in synchronized, wide-eyed horror.
Make a Luck roll. If you succeed, go to 204. If you fail, go to 196.
